project.disclaimer: Demo project. The assignment supplied no project location; חפץ חיים 25, פתח תקווה is a candidate-selected demo address (commercial submarket המרכז השקט / official neighborhood מרכז העיר). The 50% market-range-position baseline is an engineering control, not Gabay commercial strategy. Standard-unit pricing only: the 7 special (garden/duplex/triplex) units remain on the individual-review path pending a separate workstream.

methodology_notes: Each building contributes once, using the median observed price-per-sqm within the selected sale window.
Primary completed-sale lookback is 24 months; fallback is 60 months only when independent-building evidence is insufficient.
A completed sale must be within 15% of the target internal area to be a primary sold-lane contributor; the recency fallback widens time only, never this size-relevance requirement.
Current asking evidence uses exact normalized neighborhood matches when available.
Only explicitly priced unit offers are used.
Exact-neighborhood offers with known unit area can create target-equivalent indications.
Offers with missing area or from other neighborhoods remain visible as reference evidence and do not create a normalized range contribution.

strategy.disclaimer: Standard-unit pricing only (24 standard 3-room + 8 standard 5-room units). The 7 special units (garden/duplex/triplex) are out of scope for this list and remain on the individual-review path. The 50% range-position baseline is an engineering control, not a Gabay commercial decision. No floor, orientation, balcony, parking or storage premium is applied because no verified company rule for Petah Tikva was supplied.
